name: data_dictionary
description: Describe the columns of a CSV dataset and draft its data dictionary: per column the inferred type (integer, number, boolean, date, datetime, time, string), nulls, distinct values, examples, min/max and mean, and pattern hints (date format, e-mail, URL, UUID, identifier, categorical, zero-padded code, constant), plus a dictionary skeleton in JSON and Markdown with blank description fields to fill in.

path.description: Or a relative path to a CSV file inside the working directory

null_values.description: Default: empty, NA, N/A, NULL, null, None, NaN, nan, -

catalog.source: original; column profiling in the manner of pandas describe and frictionless infer, Python csv module (RFC 4180 dialects)
